## Design

### 2026-10-11 – ![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/NzKCNGh28MjASfDcrSgKIJPu5nQnCUGi/b83d09a14de28d35a853158c728bb5bc8f5b93a8ba51e34d73060ac3b3e0f17f.png)

**6.5h**

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/NzKCNGh28MjASfDcrSgKIJPu5nQnCUGi/b83d09a14de28d35a853158c728bb5bc8f5b93a8ba51e34d73060ac3b3e0f17f.png)

This was my first time ever doing something like this. Making the schematic was fun, i recognized some of the components like the resister and ground wire (i think thats what it is called) but I still have to learn the role of each component and wire. Then onto the footprint assignemnt tool, that took me forever, as i said i had never learnt it so it took me alot of youtube videos and AI. Next was the PCB editor, the star was fun to draw abd it was satisfying connecting the wire. However when i clicked design rules checker there were 9 errors and 21 warnings. Even after searching and googling im still very confused; something about a courtyard...
